title: IRIS Registry: Intelligent Research in Sight Registry
official: IRIS Registry: Intelligent Research in Sight Registry
summary: The IRIS™ Registry (Intelligent Research in Sight) is the nation's first comprehensive eye disease clinical registry. The American Academy of Ophthalmology is developing it as part of the profession's shared goal of continual improvement in the delivery of eye care.The IRIS Registry will be a centralized system for ophthalmology practices to promote practice innovations and achieve clinical excellence.
criteria:
